title: Vacuum-infiltrate ten leaf discs for a photosynthesis assay without crushing them
instruction: Prepare the ten leaf discs for the flotation assay and leave them with the solution in the clear cup, then put the syringe down and let go.
context: Biology teachers and students use syringe infiltration to establish the starting state of the floating-leaf photosynthesis assay (College Board Investigation 5; Carolina 744676, 32 students/kit). AP Biology had over 280,000 exam takers in 2025; assay participation is unmeasured. Other: teaching-lab specimen preparation. The skill is a sustained fingertip seal against plunger load, pressure restoration and intact transfer, before illumination.
setup: Needleless BD 309653 50 mL Luer-Lok syringe (older listings: 60 mL), polypropylene barrel/elastomer stopper; estimated 26 mm bore, 29 mm outside diameter, 135 mm barrel, 14 mm tip, 50 mm flange, 32 g dry barrel and 18 g removable piston with 18 mm crossed stem. Barrel horizontal along y, centre (290,0,90) mm above tabletop; stopper at same origin. Wood/acrylic open-sided holder, drawing version 2. Ten intact 6 mm spinach discs, 0.2-0.5 mm thick, 2 mL solution and approximately 30 mL trapped gas ahead of piston. Clear plastic cup, modeled 64 mm diameter x 58 mm high, at (280,170,0) mm in A or (250,180,0) mm in B, with 40 mL solution. Plastic tray 130x110x4 mm at (200,-240,0) mm. Syringe/piston starts identical across A/B; zero jitter; screenshot A. Priced real-trial kit: USD 300.70 including Carolina 744676 (55 allowance; 54.30 observed), BD box of 40 (40.70 listed), holder materials 20, hand tools 30, 6 mm punch 15, bagged spinach/reagents/measuring supplies 25, ruler/caliper/force-check reserve 20, tray/PPE 10, tax/shipping 35, pad covers/cleanup kit 50. Prices checked Nov 23; other amounts are allowances. Existing counter, timer and assessor camera. Fresh tissue is consumed; the kit does not include leaves. For physical trials: removable nitrile pad covers and spill protection; fit/seal/grip require qualification. README gives enrollment, reset and measurement checks.
scoring: Permanent 0 for a missing, crushed, holed or newly torn (>=1 mm) disc, represented apparatus failure, cup overturning (>=90 degrees), or spill >2 mL, accidental or deliberate. All ten initial discs remain the denominator and must finish in the cup. After 15 s undisturbed with cup within 5 degrees upright, count intact, freely settled discs using top/side photos and a 1 mm ruler: bottom <=3 mm above floor, >=3 mm from wall, unstacked and untrapped. Ambiguous/occluded discs do not pass. 0 for none; 0.25 for 1-4; 0.5 for 5-7; 0.75 for 8-9; 1.0 for ten. Every positive tier requires apparatus down and released, with all hand/fingertip surfaces >=30 mm clear. Full score also requires syringe, piston and cup still for 1 s (within 1 mm and 1 degree of fixed poses); ten qualifying discs before that hold earn 0.75. Average A/B. README states the separate declared simulation state/force checks and physical photo protocol.
run_limit: 2400 control steps per trial(120s at20Hz);two layouts.
reset_notes: One-person untimed estimates: 3-6 min/trial for punching, enrollment, loading, photos and cleanup; add 6-10 min/new leaf/solution batch for solution preparation and sacrificial sealed/open-tip controls (first trial 9-16 min, after one-time holder assembly). First-use dimension/force/covered-pad/photo qualification and failed-batch work are untimed. Same labeled ready-washed spinach bag/lot and solution for A/B; store per label. Proposed physical enrollment tolerances, unvalidated: punch 6.0 +/-0.2 mm, tissue 0.2-0.5 mm (sacrificial check), 2.0 +/-0.1 mL loaded, 40 +/-1 mL in cup, approximately 30 +/-1 mL trapped gas, stated poses within 2 mm/1 degree. Simulator poses remain exact. Solution: 1 detergent drop and 1 g bicarbonate per US gallon water (Carolina 2023). Before every trial reject veins, ragged/torn/holed or initially sinking discs, leaks, wet/torn covers or missing batch-control record. Count/photo all ten initially floating intact discs with ruler; direct assay light off. No specimen substitution after start. Reset kit: punch, spare syringe, volume measures, ruler/template, timer, rinse bottle, pad covers, absorbent pads, dry wipes and waste bag. Rinse/dry apparatus; inspect protected pads and restore A/B poses/empty tray. Record measurements and all preparation/rejection time. Kit excludes leaves; no suitable ready-made discs/replica identified. Tissue response and covered-pad grip/seal remain unqualified. Simulator reset restores states in a new process.
fidelity: Rigid syringe/piston; removable bearing. Estimated Boyle load (30 mL gas, 26 mm bore, 32 N cap), equal/opposite at 20 Hz. Fingertip contact seals outlet. Declared tissue needs 30-55 mm loaded expansion, >=25 kPa reduction, 8.2-10 s continuous hold and pressure restoration. Drainage checks cup/drop path and liquid inventory. Damage uses an uncalibrated 1 N proxy. Fresh-tissue response, dimensions, covered-pad seal/grip and photo repeatability need physical qualification; covers are not simulated.
scores: Demo A1.0/B1.0,mean1.0. Dream-1 A0.0/B0.0,mean0.0;2400steps/lot,max_steps,65expired-response warnings,no evaluation error/refusal. Frozen216401f6.
